# tangwar — #87–#98 rewrite notes

Patches: `scripts/.cache/rewrite/tangwar.mjs` (idempotent, via `editStory`). Pre-run backup: `/tmp/story-before-tangwar.json`.
Checks: `validate.mjs 87 98` → ok. No unmatched image anchors in #87–#98 (the baseline `lotus tiles` / `a stone lantern` case mismatches in #98 are fixed).

## #87 Mount Gain
- Changed: a 668 ancestral-temple frame motivates the step back ("go back three summers"). The covenant copy sits beside Muyeol's tablet. The episode closes on Munmu asking "Who was the first king of this land?", which sets up #88. Cut duplicate quote [11] and covenant block [24].
- First: "The night Pyongyang falls, the king of Silla goes to visit a piece of paper."
- Card (23, kept): "To find the first king of this land, we have to go back before there were kingdoms… to a bear in a cave…!"

## #88 Dangun & Old Joseon
- Changed: the present-day reason now comes from #87's question. The laws move ahead of the short retelling, the summary quote moves after the Dangun card, minor names are trimmed, and a coda returns to Munmu ("with extra garlic… He keeps thinking about the door").
- First (kept): "Before there are any kingdoms, there is a son in heaven who keeps looking down."
- Card (24, kept): "Eight hundred years later, the empire comes back…"

## #89 Anseung
- Changed: no longer recaps its card. Cut quotes [4] and [14]. Added a River Camp quarrel, the tent killing, Munmu's "Be reverent… Twice", and an empty-tent beat.
- First: "Every revival needs two things: a flag and a royal. Geom Mojam has the flag."
- Card (21): "The emperor hears there is a king of Goguryeo in Silla. His general reaches for a brush instead of a sword…!"

## #90 Letters
- Changed: cut quotes [15] and [17]. Added a narrator wink ("has a cicada in it") before Xue's record quote.
- Card (16, kept): "The Tang are coming south. Silla is winning. That is exactly when armies start to chase…!"

## #91 Stone Gate
- Changed: no longer opens on place names. Added the Wonsul/Danneung chase and bridle scene. Added an apology-letter court scene ("My father. Thirteen years ago. I'm only signing it.") that frames the flashback. Cut quotes [5] and [6].
- First: "Winning is the most dangerous thing an army can do."
- Card (12): "Wonsul came home alive. In his father’s house, that is the crime…!"

## #92 Wonsul
- Changed: planted Lady Jiso's lamp. Cut quote [1]. Added the "Retreat… I was fifteen" callback and Yushin's "…You were not my son."
- First: "Wonsul gets home a day before the news does. It doesn’t help."
- Card (21, kept).

## #93 Kim Yushin†
- Changed: Yushin asks after Wonsul. Cut quote [17] and the Daeto aside. The obituary is compressed to one paragraph. Munhee sees her brother walking with his escort under the eastern star. Lady Jiso: "The lamp is out." Kangrim's question was left untouched.
- Card (20): "The king has buried his uncle. He still has one letter to answer, and a path nobody ever showed him…!"

## #94 The Wanggeom's Guest
- Changed: new opening on Daeto's letter and arrest (he copies his own death warrant). Cut seven narration/quote blocks and removed one spoiler.
- First: "The day after the funeral, a letter falls out of a sleeve."
- Card (13, kept).

## #95 Maeso
- Changed: added a Punghun–Xue deck scene and Punghun's fate. Planted Sideuk ("Wet sand. I'll remember that."). Wonsul refuses rank ("Lieutenant. Of Seokmun."). Cut three quotes.
- Card (18): "One last river mouth. One captain who has never won a fight. Three tries to end a war…!"

## #96 Final Ford (377 → 531 words)
- Changed: Xue is now on the page (flagship, ancestors callback, exit west). Sideuk's third sortie pays off #95. Added Munmu's "Have we… won…?" and the scribe's "Nobody has told us we haven't." Cut the formation, the messenger and a quote.
- Card (24, kept).

## #97 The King for All (578 → 1170 words)
- Changed: Inmun's letter (his second appearance). New climax in the hall: doors opened to the yard, war grain debts cancelled, Baekje and Goguryeo men given Silla ranks, a True Bone elder answered with "Even the bone people… I meant you, my lord." Added an eastern-star resolution, the broken iron oath beside Muyeol's tablet, and the last edict. Kangrim's moment: "Were you a king of Silla — or a king for all?" / "Ask the ones with no bone. There are more of them." The 692 tablet beat now pays off the Thirty-Three Heavens plant.
- First (kept). Card (21, kept): "But we left someone in the snow…!"

## #98 Balhae
- Changed: compressed the replayed doorway flashback. Cut the coda records and the era label. Added the "two kings under one sky" coda. The final line is "Dae Joyoung keeps walking north, one hand on the gold under his coat." THE END stays as the last small line.
- No card (series end).
